title: Cozy Night In
reference_source: Референс 2 — пижама в сердечко, спальня ночью, взгляд через плечо
mood_ru: Мягкая, домашняя, сонная. Тёплый свет, ночной город за окном, минимум резких теней.

wardrobe.prompt: fitted cream white cropped camisole with tiny pink ditsy floral print and thin adjustable straps, matching white ruffled-hem pajama shorts with a small pink heart print and a little satin bow at the waistband, cream knit knee-high socks with pink bows at the cuff, thin silver chain with small star pendant, dark brown messy high bun with loose strands, soft natural makeup with flushed cheeks
wardrobe.notes_ru: Ткань плотная, непрозрачная. Гольфы и бантики — обязательный continuity-маркер сессии.

location.prompt: cozy modern bedroom at night, floor-to-ceiling window with blurred city bokeh lights, wall of pinned polaroid photographs, vanity desk with a lit mirror and makeup brushes, lit candles, pink tulips in a glass vase, quilted cream bedspread, chunky pink plush throw blanket, cream teddy bear, open laptop glowing, trailing pothos plant, warm string fairy lights
location.notes_ru: Одна комната, ночь. Тёплые лампы + холодный город за стеклом — держать этот контраст.

shots.title_ru: Взгляд через плечо на кровати (реконструкция референса)
shots.pose: kneeling and sitting back on her heels in the middle of the bed with her back to the camera, spine gently arched, left hand planted on the bedspread beside her, head turned over the right shoulder looking directly into the lens with a soft neutral expression
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level looking down, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: warm vanity lamp and candle glow from camera left, cool blue city window light spilling across her back from the right

shots.pose: lying on her stomach across the bed, ankles crossed and lifted in the air, chin resting on both hands, elbows sinking into the quilt, open laptop in front of her, eyes flicking up to the camera with a small amused smile
shots.camera: 50mm lens, low camera at mattress level, side three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: cool laptop screen glow on the face, warm fairy lights behind, candle flicker in the background bokeh

shots.pose: sitting cross-legged in the center of the bed wrapped loosely in the pink plush blanket, holding a ceramic mug of cappuccino with both hands close to her chest, shoulders relaxed, warm gentle smile toward the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, frontal, waist-up framing
shots.light: warm candle key from camera right, soft ambient fill, rising steam catching the backlight

shots.pose: standing barefoot-in-socks at the floor-to-ceiling window, one palm and forehead resting against the cold glass, weight on one hip, looking out at the city, seen from behind and slightly to the side
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: near-silhouette against the city bokeh, faint warm room light tracing the shoulder and the bun, blue-cyan window color cast

shots.pose: sitting on the vanity stool leaning in toward the lit mirror, applying lip balm with one finger, other hand steadying on the desk, her face visible in the mirror reflection while the camera sees her from behind
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the mirror, waist-up framing
shots.light: even warm bulb light from the mirror frame on the face, dim room behind falling into shadow

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of her knees drawn up on the quilt, one hand adjusting the pink bow on the knit knee-high sock, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm macro-leaning lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: soft warm side light, candle bokeh balls in the background, gentle texture on the knit and the quilt

shots.pose: sitting on the edge of the bed with feet on the rug, both arms stretched overhead with fingers interlaced, back arched in a sleepy stretch, eyes closed, head tilted back, mid-yawn
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, side three-quarter angle, full body framing
shots.light: warm bedside lamp key from behind creating a halo through the loose hair, low ambient fill on the front

shots.pose: curled up on her side under the pink plush blanket pulled up to the chin, cream teddy bear tucked beside her cheek, only face and one shoulder visible, big soft eye contact with the camera
shots.camera: 85mm portrait lens, low camera at pillow level, frontal, tight head-and-shoulders framing
shots.light: single warm candle key close to the face, deep soft shadows, cool city light as a faint hair rim

shots.title_ru: Скроллит телефон при свечах, вид сверху
shots.pose: lying on her back across the quilt with her head hanging slightly off the edge, holding a phone above her face with both hands, knees bent, one sock-clad foot crossed over the other, absorbed expression
shots.camera: 35mm lens, high three-quarter angle looking down from above the bed, full body framing
shots.light: cool phone-screen glow on the face and hands, warm candle rim from the side, dark surrounding room

shots.title_ru: Общий план комнаты из дверного проёма
shots.pose: seen from across the room sitting small in the middle of the big bed, legs folded, laptop open on her lap, head turned toward the camera as if just noticing it, calm quiet expression
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, framed through the bedroom doorway, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: room mostly dark, laptop and fairy lights as the only warm sources, city window glowing cool behind her

allure: flirtatious intimate mood, soft pajama set hugging her curves, deeply arched lower back, long bare legs and thighs, teasing half-lidded glance over the shoulder
